assumption_catalog.label: continuous operator substrate
assumption_catalog.description: The Cantor substrate is a continuously evolving kernel/operator state, not a finite map list.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: continuous_kernel_pilot report plus the non-finite-state-like sweep signature.

assumption_catalog.label: full six-primitive closure
assumption_catalog.description: All six primitives are causally active in one loop, and each materially matters under knockout.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: pilot knockout report with all six removals and material degradation.

assumption_catalog.label: P1 rewrite active
assumption_catalog.description: Kernel rewrite is causally driven by the selected packaging and lens.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: P1 knockout materially degrades the loop and suppresses tau switching.

assumption_catalog.label: P2 gating active
assumption_catalog.description: Support/viability gating depends on the active packaging and affects the next substrate.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: P2 knockout materially degrades the loop and changes the stability regime.

assumption_catalog.label: P3 timescale adaptation
assumption_catalog.description: The substrate has an active tau/protocol adaptation mechanism.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: tau_switch_count is nonzero in the pilot and sweep.

assumption_catalog.label: P4 nondegenerate lens competition
assumption_catalog.description: Lens selection is competitive and switches among distinct lenses in a nontrivial way.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: Three-way lens switching in the pilot and sweep.

assumption_catalog.label: P5 nondegenerate packaging competition
assumption_catalog.description: Packaging selection is competitive and changes the next substrate causally.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: Three-way packaging switching in the pilot; P5 knockout collapses packaging switching.

assumption_catalog.label: P6 budget dynamics active
assumption_catalog.description: The budget/income/cost ledger actively modulates the loop.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: Budget volatility is large and P6 knockout collapses the budget range.

assumption_catalog.label: primitive knockout fragility
assumption_catalog.description: Removing any one primitive materially degrades the loop.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: All six knockouts in the pilot report are materially degrading.

assumption_catalog.label: persistent kernel variation
assumption_catalog.description: The kernel remains dynamically active rather than freezing.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: Mean variation stays around 0.17-0.20 and never collapses to near zero in the sweep.

assumption_catalog.label: hysteresis-stabilized selection
assumption_catalog.description: Selection is stabilized by hysteresis, not by collapse to a single static choice.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: Switch rates remain bounded away from 0 and 1 while staying regular.

assumption_catalog.label: lawful exploratory regime
assumption_catalog.description: The continuous regime is exploratory but still lawful, not pathological.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: All sweep runs are labeled lawful_exploratory.

assumption_catalog.label: no fast collapse
assumption_catalog.description: The regime does not quickly collapse into a frozen or near-frozen state.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: No near-frozen or collapsed runs appear in the sweep window.

assumption_catalog.label: parameter-shell robustness
assumption_catalog.description: The lawful regime persists across a modest shell of nearby parameters.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: 12/12 sweep runs remain lawful_exploratory across two sizes, three seeds, and two parameter sets.

assumption_catalog.label: generated object extraction plausible
assumption_catalog.description: The later theorem can be stated on the generated kernel-family object rather than on a raw trajectory.
assumption_catalog.empirical_proxy: The working pilot and sweep define a stable generated family and regime shell.
